nodes.name: client.rs
nodes.summary: Thin GraphQL wrapper around https://api.linear.app/graphql: reqwest client construction (rustls), bearer-token auth, HTTP-status-to-SyncError mapping, and GraphQL errors[] extraction so a 200 OK with errors surfaces as the right SyncError variant.

nodes.name: LinearClient::with_endpoint
nodes.summary: Builds a LinearClient pointed at a custom GraphQL endpoint, used by tests against a mock server.

nodes.name: LinearClient::graphql
nodes.summary: Issues an authenticated GraphQL request against the Linear API and maps the HTTP/GraphQL response into parsed data or a SyncError.

nodes.name: extract_data
nodes.summary: Extracts the `data` field from a Linear GraphQL response, mapping a top-level errors[] array into the appropriate SyncError variant.

nodes.name: truncate
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to a maximum length for error-message display, appending an ellipsis marker.

nodes.name: LinearClient
nodes.summary: Thin reqwest-backed GraphQL client for the Linear adapter; knows only the endpoint URL, auth, and GraphQL error mapping -- no Linear domain logic.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Linear sync adapter implementing SyncAdapter against Linear's GraphQL API, split across mod.rs (trait impl + field map + descriptor), parse.rs (pure JSON<->wire-shape converters), and client.rs (reqwest/GraphQL transport). Auth tokens are stored in the global sync connection token store, kept separate from key_vault::KeyService.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::push
nodes.summary: Pushes one outbox entry (create/update) to Linear via a GraphQL mutation, built from parse::build_issue_update_input.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::pull
nodes.summary: Fetches Linear issues updated since a cursor via a paginated GraphQL query, converting them to ExternalChange via parse::parse_linear_issue.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::descriptor
nodes.summary: Returns the Linear adapter's AdapterDescriptor (id, label, OAuth/PAT auth methods, webhook/import support flags).

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::pull_all
nodes.summary: Paginates through all Linear issues for a bulk import using `first`/`after` cursors, converting each page via parse::parse_linear_issue.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::verify_webhook
nodes.summary: Verifies a Linear webhook's HMAC signature against the configured secret.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter::handle_webhook
nodes.summary: Parses a verified Linear webhook payload into ExternalChange entries via parse::parse_linear_webhook_payload.

nodes.name: LinearAdapter
nodes.summary: SyncAdapter implementation for Linear issues, delegating GraphQL transport to client.rs and JSON mapping to parse.rs.

nodes.name: parse.rs
nodes.summary: Pure mapping helpers between Linear's GraphQL issue shape and the adapter's canonical wire types (ExternalChange, IssueUpdateInput), kept dependency-free of HTTP so every function is testable as Value -> Value / Value -> ExternalChange.

nodes.name: normalize_linear_status
nodes.summary: Maps a Linear workflow state (name + type) onto the local WorkItemStatus enum.

nodes.name: parse_linear_issue
nodes.summary: Converts a raw Linear GraphQL issue node into a canonical ExternalChange, mapping labels, assignee, state, and estimate fields.

nodes.name: build_issue_update_input
nodes.summary: Builds the Linear GraphQL IssueUpdateInput variables object for updating an issue from the local WorkItem's writable fields.

nodes.name: parse_linear_webhook_payload
nodes.summary: Converts a verified Linear webhook event payload into ExternalChange entries.

nodes.name: op_to_mutation
nodes.summary: Maps an OutboxOp (create/update/delete) onto the Linear GraphQL mutation name to invoke.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Built-in SyncAdapter implementations plus a lazy registry: echo::EchoAdapter (test/manual smoke), linear (GraphQL), github (REST). The registry is a OnceLock<HashMap> populated at first access, giving O(1) lookups for the process lifetime.

nodes.name: build_registry
nodes.summary: Constructs the adapter registry map, instantiating and boxing each built-in adapter (echo, linear, github) keyed by adapter id.

nodes.name: collab_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: TS-bridge for the orgii_collab sync provider (design section 16.8). Shared projects/work items are native local rows under a project_orgs row aliased to the collab org; local mutations enqueue outbox rows with org_id set, routing them to this bridge instead of the in-process worker. Supabase HTTP and credentials never enter Rust -- the TS CollabSyncEngine drives three Tauri commands: drain_outbox, ack_outbox, and apply_remote.
nodes.languageNotes: At 3008 lines this is the largest file in the batch; it is organized as three symmetric push/ack/apply phases mirroring a bidirectional OCC (optimistic concurrency control) sync protocol against Supabase, driven entirely from the TypeScript side.

nodes.name: is_collab_org
nodes.summary: Checks whether a project_orgs row is aliased to the collab provider (source='collab', sync_provider='orgii_collab').

nodes.name: collab_org_for_project
nodes.summary: Resolves the collab project_orgs row (if any) that owns a given project slug.

nodes.name: append_collab_row
nodes.summary: Appends a row to outbox_entries scoped to a collab org_id, coalescing per-entity field_path trails, so it routes to the collab bridge instead of the in-process worker.

nodes.name: record_project_work_item_update
nodes.summary: Records a local field-level mutation on a work item as a pending collab outbox row when its project belongs to a collab org.

nodes.name: record_work_item_write
nodes.summary: Records a local work-item create/update/delete as a pending collab outbox row.

nodes.name: record_project_write
nodes.summary: Records a local project create/update as a pending collab outbox row.

nodes.name: outbox_pending_ids
nodes.summary: Lists the outbox_entries ids still pending push for a collab org, oldest first.

nodes.name: drain_outbox
nodes.summary: Tauri command: claims pending collab outbox rows oldest-first, coalesces them per entity, and hydrates a full wire-shaped snapshot of each entity's current local state for the TS CollabSyncEngine to push to Supabase.

nodes.name: hydrate_project
nodes.summary: Builds the wire-shaped snapshot (fields plus per-field mtime map) of a project's current local state for a collab push.

nodes.name: read_project_remote_version
nodes.summary: Reads the last-known remote OCC version stamped on a project row.

nodes.name: hydrate_work_item
nodes.summary: Builds the wire-shaped snapshot (fields plus per-field mtime map) of a work item's current local state for a collab push.

nodes.name: work_item_wire
nodes.summary: Assembles the wire payload for a work item from its frontmatter, body, and per-field revision sources.

nodes.name: ack_outbox
nodes.summary: Tauri command: acknowledges pushed collab outbox rows, recording each entity's new remote OCC version or surfacing push errors.

nodes.name: store_remote_version
nodes.summary: Persists the remote OCC version returned by a successful collab push onto the local project/work-item row.

nodes.name: apply_remote
nodes.summary: Tauri command: applies a batch of remote collab entities (projects/work items) pushed down from Supabase realtime, upserting each as a native local row.

nodes.name: ensure_collab_project_org
nodes.summary: Ensures a project_orgs row exists aliasing a given collab org id, creating it on first sight of a remote org.

nodes.name: newer_pending_fields
nodes.summary: Determines which fields have a newer pending local outbox mutation than the incoming remote change, so those fields are excluded from the remote merge.

nodes.name: has_pending_outbox_rows
nodes.summary: Checks whether an entity still has any pending (unpushed) collab outbox rows.

nodes.name: apply_project
nodes.summary: Merges a remote collab project entity into the local projects table field-by-field, skipping fields with newer pending local writes and reconciling the slug on conflict.

nodes.name: project_fields_from_wire
nodes.summary: Extracts the flat field-value map from a project's wire payload.

nodes.name: apply_adopted_project_field
nodes.summary: Applies one adopted remote field value onto a ProjectMeta/description pair by field name.

nodes.name: unique_project_slug
nodes.summary: Generates a project slug that doesn't collide with an existing project, disambiguating with a numeric suffix.

nodes.name: parse_wire_field_mtimes
nodes.summary: Parses the per-field mtime map out of a wire payload.

nodes.name: work_item_fields_from_wire
nodes.summary: Extracts the flat field-value map from a work item's wire payload.

nodes.name: frontmatter_from_wire
nodes.summary: Builds a WorkItemFrontmatter from a remote work item's wire payload and project/work-item ids.

nodes.name: apply_work_item
nodes.summary: Merges a remote collab work item entity into the local workitems table field-by-field, skipping fields with newer pending local writes.

nodes.name: apply_wire_tail
nodes.summary: Merges non-conflicting tail fields (todos, comments, history, etc.) from a remote wire payload into a WorkItemPartialUpdate.

nodes.name: apply_wire_tail_union
nodes.summary: Merges tail fields using set-union semantics (combining local and remote entries) instead of remote-wins.

nodes.name: union_by_key
nodes.summary: Generic helper that unions two lists of keyed items, preferring the local entry on key collision.
